note: Territory overlay, one 32x16 diamond per owned tile (the 3x3 around an owned landmark). Column = which edge-sharing neighbours are also this team's territory (NE=1, SE=2, SW=4, NW=8); open edges get a bright team border with a soft inner band, so the 3x3 reads as one outlined region. Fill is 18% alpha so terrain shows through. Draw after ground and roads, before objects and units.
